hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'a=scripts/codex-hook-adapter.py; r=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}; if [ -z "$r" ]; then echo "codex-hook: PLUGIN_ROOT is unset, so the adapter cannot be located; refusing this call" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ ! -f "$r/$a" ]; then n=0; for d in "${r%/*}"/*/; do if [ -f "$d$a" ]; then c=${d%/}; n=$((n+1)); fi; done; if [ "$n" -ne 1 ]; then echo "codex-hook: this session registered $r, which no longer exists, and $n installed versions carry the adapter; refusing this call. Restart the Codex session." >&2; exit 2; fi; r=$c; fi; exec python3 "$r/$a"'
